trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    reds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    if not pts or not reds:return out
    dr=dc=0
    if len(set(r for r,c in reds))==1:
        line=reds[0][0]
        lo=min(r for r,c in pts); hi=max(r for r,c in pts)
        if hi<line:dr=line-1-hi
        elif lo>line:dr=line+1-lo
    else:
        line=reds[0][1]
        lo=min(c for r,c in pts);hi=max(c for r,c in pts)
        if hi<line:dc=line-1-hi
        elif lo>line:dc=line+1-lo
    for r,c in pts:out[r][c]=0
    for r,c in pts:
        if 0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w:out[r+dr][c+dc]=1
    return out
